title: Store credit on its own card
narrative: The same support agent that handles refunds can carry a separate card for retention credits. Eligibility comes from this domain and each authorized credit draws only from the credit card's daily balance.

steps.description: A retention case is marked eligible for store credit.
Eligibility is not authority. With no Store Credit Card, the proposal is refused.
An owner issues a Store Credit Card with a €2,000 daily ceiling.
KIFF authorizes €750 of credit and draws it from this card. The commerce system issues the credit afterwards.
A €1,500 proposal does not fit the €1,250 remaining. Refund and plan-change cards are unaffected.
